layers.name: Illustration
layers.contents: Skater, skateboard, trick, coastal environment; no card wording, numbers or UI graphics.
layers.format: Clean PNG master and SVG layout; exported PNG at the shared canvas size

layers.name: Graphisme
layers.contents: Cream border, navy title band, turquoise waves, orange panels, blank score area and blank dice sockets; no semantic text or icons.

layers.name: Textes et symboles
layers.contents: Name, type glyph, tier, six-dice probability, dice requirements, printed points and card bonus.
layers.format: Editable SVG generated from catalog fields recorded in card.json, with transparent PNG export

rulesSource: tests/fixtures/theory85-catalog.json with the tested +2 premium for three- and four-die cards
font: Impact with Arial Narrow/sans-serif fallback; PNG exports preserve the rendered font
workflow: Validate illustration framing and trick anatomy separately.
Validate the shared graphic frame once, including its 2/3/4-die variants.
Validate card.json requirements, score and effect against the approved catalog.
Generate the information layer from data and assemble the three layers.
Inspect the full-size card and a small in-game-size preview.
notes: These examples are not inserted into the playable game.
PNG layers share one origin, dimensions and alpha; assembly is exactly their ordered composition.
Rule changes never require regenerating illustration artwork; changing dice cost also selects the appropriate blank-socket frame.
Displayed percentages use six ordinary dice without tokens or the personal wildcard.
The source illustration is a draft; visual approval of the template does not approve every trick depiction.
